data.title: SkillGuard: scan a Claude Code skill or MCP server for malware before you install it
data.description: A free CLI that statically scans Claude Code skills, plugins, and MCP servers for env-var exfiltration, install-time shell hooks, prompt injection, and committed malware, before you install. Never runs the scanned code. Paid deep audit + continuous watch available.

h1: Scan a Claude Code skill or MCP server for malware before you install it.
h2: Stop worrying about what you install

data.text: The skill/MCP ecosystem is exploding, and so is the attack surface. SkillGuard statically scans any skill, plugin, or MCP server for the patterns attackers actually use, in seconds. Free, no signup, and it never runs the code it's inspecting.
